title: A residue-field line is the generic stalk of the closed structure pushforward
statement: Let $i:W\to X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with $W$ integral [def-pc-integral-scheme]. If the generic stalk of an $\mathcal O_X$-module $G$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] has a compatible $\kappa(i(\eta))$-module structure [def-weil-residue-field] of finrank one, then it is isomorphic, as an ambient stalk-ring module, to the stalk of $i_*\mathcal O_W$ [def-pc-module-pullback] at $i(\eta)$. No coherence, ideal, global map, or annihilation hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: Apply the existing public ideal_module_product_stalk theorem to the identity inclusion of the structure module on W, and retain its structure-stalk isomorphism and germ compatibility. This reuses the library comparison rather than reproving the private unit_stalk_iso helper. Closed-pushforward comparison identifies the ambient source stalk with this stalk and describes its ambient scalar action.

The generic local ring is a field. Descend the surjective local stalk map by IsLocalRing.ResidueField.lift; its field source makes it injective and stalk-map surjectivity makes it surjective. Module.nonempty_linearEquiv_of_finrank_eq_one identifies the target line with the residue field. Compose these bijections, prove ambient-ring linearity from scalar compatibility, and use LinearEquiv.ofBijective.toModuleIso.

theorem rank_one_generic_structure_stalk_iso {X W : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : W ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsIntegral W]
    (G : X.Modules)
    (hGrank : ∃ _inst : Module (X.residueField (i.base (genericPoint W)))
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace (i.base (genericPoint W))).obj G),
      (∀ (a : X.presheaf.stalk (i.base (genericPoint W)))
        (v : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace
          (i.base (genericPoint W))).obj G),
        a • v = (X.residue (i.base (genericPoint W))) a • v) ∧
      Module.finrank (X.residueField (i.base (genericPoint W)))
        ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace
          (i.base (genericPoint W))).obj G) = 1) :
    Nonempty ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace
      (i.base (genericPoint W))).obj ((pushforward i).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit W.ringCatSheaf)) ≅
      (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace
        (i.base (genericPoint W))).obj G)
